entities.name: Péter Nagy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Péter Nagy is a Hungarian weightlifter. He competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the +105 kg event. Nagy won a bronze medal in the +105 kg snatch at the 2012 European Weightlifting Championships and a gold medal at the 2011 Summer Universiade.
